title: Foundation Engine
description: My personal 3D game engine developed in C++
content: This project involved creating a 3D engine from the ground up using C++ for the core logic and HLSL for compute shaders.
The engine supports basic rendering, lighting, and camera controls. It was a challenging yet rewarding experience that deepened
my understanding of graphics programming and low-level system architecture.

title: Isosurface Algorithms
description: An investigation into Isosurface algorithms, compute shaders and DirectX 12
content: As part of my honours research, I created an application which allowed the user to edit voxel terrain using several techniques.
The terrain was polygonised using isosurface techniques, including modified marching cubes and a dual contouring algorithm.
In an effort to improve the efficiency, both the marching cubes algorithm and dual contouring algorithm were implemented on the GPU through the compute shader.
